title: Whisper keeps writing my wake word as "Manah"
body: In my voice transcripts, whisper wrote "Manah" six times when I said "Mana". The base whisper prompt in `node-bot/whisper-prompt.js` lists the wake-word misspellings ("Mana, Manah, Manna, Mannah, Myna, My Na"), and whisper copies spellings it sees in the prompt, so it's teaching whisper to misspell her name. `WakeWordMatcher` already accepts those variants on its own, so the prompt only needs to say "Mana".
why: A one-line prompt-string fix in whisper-prompt.js where the issue names the file and the behaviour. Checks she edits the string the issue points at and nothing else.
